messages:
maria: Quick RFC follow-up: leaning toward subqueue-fences + opportunistic prefetch. Need eviction contract, pacing knobs, and telemetry before we ship.
sam: Concern: many tiny fenced subqueues -> metadata fragmentation and GC spikes.
lee: Agree. Also need clear quotas so prefetchers don't starve inflight SLOs.
anika: Draft eviction contract: soft-evict cancels prefetches and deprioritizes queue, inflight allowed to drain; hard-evict cancels inflight only on SLO breach or emergency reclaim. Reclaim order: prefetches -> queued -> inflight small -> inflight large.
sam: Killing inflight small batches risks client retransmit loops. Include retry/idempotency guidance.
lee: Accounting: prefetch memory charged to tenant prefetch_quota (soft), inflight_quota enforced strictly. Provide defaults in docs.
anika: Telemetry: per-subqueue metrics (queued_tokens, prefetch_tokens, inflight_tokens), eviction events (tenant, model, reason), eviction_rebuild_cost, post-eviction latency histogram. Retention: traces 7d, rollups 90d.
maria: Handoff (local fences): origin marks "handing-off", drains bounded window, writes checkpoint {tenant,model,kv_keys,seq_hint,queued_tokens}, target claims and resumes prefetch. Checkpoint is best-effort; callers tolerate warm-up.
sam: Central lease broker vs local fences: prefer local fences + cross-shard reconciliation; central broker as fallback for ops.
lee: Add pacing knob per-tenant (token-bucket) to slow noisy prefetchers.
ci-bot: Branch continuous-batching/subqueue-fence updated, CI green.
maria: Action items: sam draft eviction + retry semantics; lee POC local-fence; anika telemetry tickets; maria update RFC. Closing for now.
